newsitem.title: THAILAND: SingTel signs agreement with Thailand.
newsitem.headline: SingTel signs agreement with Thailand.

text.p: Singapore Telecommunications Ltd (SingTel) on Thursday signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) with state-run Telephone Organization of Thailand (TOT), a TOT spokeswoman said.
Under terms of the MOU, both sides would cooperate on exchange of technical know-how, promote exchange of information and training programmes, the spokeswoman said.
TOT had earlier signed similar agreements with eight countries including Laos, South Korea, Japan, Malaysia, Australia, Sweden, France and Germany.
